analysis_md:
$dz=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}dx+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}dy，x=0\quad y=0\quad z=0$

两边对 $x$ 求导 $e^{x+2y+3z}\cdot(3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+1)+yz+xy\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=0$

代入 $x=0，y=0$，$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{x=0}=-\frac{1}{3}$

两边对 $y$ 求导 $e^{x+2y+3z}\cdot(3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+2)+xz+xy\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0$

$\Rightarrow\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{y=0}= -\frac{2}{3}$

代入 $x=0，y=0$

$\Rightarrow dz\big|_{(0,0)}=-\frac{1}{3}dx-\frac{2}{3}dy$
